Homepage forms: 0 Visible homepage text: How It Works | Fairway Cars Fairway Cars Home How It Works About Contact Get A Quote How It Works Selling your car to Fairway Cars is quick, easy, and completely hassle-free. 1 Step One Enter Your Registration Head to our homepage and pop your car's registration plate into our free lookup tool. We'll instantly pull up your vehicle details from the DVLA database — make, model, year, colour, and more. This helps us give you the most accurate valuation possible right from the start. 🔍 2 Step Two Get Your Free Valuation Once we've got your vehicle details, we'll give you a fair, honest valuation. No games, no lowballing — just a genuine price for your car. Already got a WeBuyAnyCar or part-exchange quote? Bring it to us, and if we can beat it, we will. 💷 3 Step Three We Collect & You Get Paid Happy with the price? We'll come to you and collect your car for free — no need to drive anywhere. You'll get paid in cash or by bank transfer, on the spot. No waiting hours or days for bank transfers, no paperwork headaches. We handle everything so you don't have to. 🚗 Got Questions? Frequently Asked What types of cars do you buy? + We buy all types of cars, vans, and light commercial vehicles. Whether it's a city runaround or a family SUV, we're interested. All makes, models, ages, and conditions considered. Can you really beat WeBuyAnyCar? + Yes. Bring us your WeBuyAnyCar offer and we can usually beat it.
